1.5T の脂肪の T1 は約 250〜300 ms、ヌルポイントは TI ≈: At 1.5 T, fat T1 is about 250–300 ms, so the null point is TI ≈ 150–170 ms.

3T で受信バンド幅が狭く、脂肪と水の境界がずれています。化学シフトを 1 画素: At 3 T the receiver bandwidth is narrow and the fat–water boundary is shifted. Reduce the chemical shift to 1 pixel or less.
3T の EPI で読出しが長く、歪みが目立ちます。EPI の読出し時間を 30: The 3 T EPI readout is long and distortion is obvious. Bring the EPI readout time down to 30 ms or less.
3T の水脂肪差は約 440 Hz。バンド幅を 440 Hz/画素以上にします（: The water–fat difference at 3 T is about 440 Hz. Set the bandwidth to at least 440 Hz/pixel (SNR will drop).
CNR は信号差 × SNR で決まります。TR を T1 の間に置くと差が大き: CNR is the signal difference × SNR. Placing TR between the two T1 values widens the difference, and spending the saved time on averaging raises SNR by √NEX. Keep the trade-off with resolution (voxel volume) in mind.
EPI では位相方向の 1 画素あたりの帯域が狭く（1 ÷ 読出し時間）、磁場の: In EPI the bandwidth per pixel in the phase direction is small (1 ÷ readout time), so any field offset becomes a shift along the phase direction. The shorter the readout, the smaller the distortion.
ETL（エコートレイン長）を増やすと、1 回の TR で取るライン数が増えて速く: Increasing the ETL (echo train length) acquires more lines per TR, so the scan gets faster.
FOV を広げると時間が延びます。並列画像（加速）や部分フーリエで取り戻しましょ: A larger FOV lengthens the scan. Win the time back with parallel imaging or partial Fourier.
FSE の時間は TR × 位相数 × 加算 ÷ ETL。ETL を伸ばすと速く: FSE time is TR × phase steps × averages ÷ ETL. A longer ETL is faster, but T2 decay along the train adds blurring and SAR rises.
SE T1 強調で、白質と灰白質の CNR を 12 以上にしてください。ただし: On SE T1-weighted imaging, raise the white–grey matter CNR to 12 or more, keeping the scan within 4 minutes.
SNR を上げるには、スライス厚・FOV を大きく、マトリクスを小さく、加算を増: To raise SNR: thicker slices, larger FOV, smaller matrix, more averages, or a narrower bandwidth.
SNRを6割以上・撮像時間を3割増以内に保って、画素（ボクセル）を小さくします。: Makes voxels smaller while keeping SNR ≥ 60% and scan time ≤ +30%. The FOV is not changed.
SNRを7割以上・分解能とコントラスト（TE・TR・TI・フリップ角）を保ったま: Shortens the scan with acceleration, averaging, ETL and bandwidth while keeping SNR ≥ 70% and the resolution and contrast (TE, TR, TI, flip angle) unchanged.
STIR は脂肪の T1 に合わせて TI を決めます。: In STIR, the TI is chosen to match the T1 of fat.
T1 強調では TR を短く、TE を短くするとコントラストが出ます。: For T1 weighting, use a short TR and a short TE.
T2 強調は「長い TR」と「長い TE」です。: T2 weighting means a long TR and a long TE.
TI ≈ T1 × ln2（≈ 0.69 × T1）で縦磁化が 0 になり、その: At TI ≈ T1 × ln2 (≈ 0.69 × T1) the longitudinal magnetization crosses zero and that tissue disappears. With a finite TR, TI ≈ T1 × ln[2 / (1 + e^(−TR/T1))].
TR が短いと完全に回復しないので、最適な TI は短めにずれます。グラフの横軸: With a short TR the magnetization does not fully recover, so the best TI shifts shorter. Try setting the chart x-axis to TI.
TR は T1 の影響を消すため 2500 ms 以上、TE は 80〜120: Use TR ≥ 2500 ms to remove T1 effects and TE of roughly 80–120 ms.

ヌルポイントは TI ≈ T1 × ln2（TR が十分長いとき）。脳脊髄液の: The null point is TI ≈ T1 × ln2 (when TR is long enough). CSF T1 is about 4000 ms at 1.5 T.
バンド幅を広げる、ビュー角傾斜（VAT）、スライス方向の補正（SEMAC）が有効: A wider bandwidth, view-angle tilting (VAT) and slice-direction correction (SEMAC) help.
バンド幅を広げると 1 画素あたりの周波数幅が増え、ずれ（画素数）が減ります。代: A wider bandwidth increases the frequency range per pixel, so the shift (in pixels) shrinks. In exchange noise rises and SNR falls in proportion to 1/√(BW).

並列画像（R）でエコー列を短くする、位相マトリクスを減らす、部分フーリエ、読出し: Shorten the echo train with parallel imaging (R), reduce the phase matrix, use partial Fourier, or segmented readout (RESOLVE, EPIX, etc.).
並列画像（加速）・部分フーリエ・パーティション数の削減が効きます。: Parallel imaging (acceleration), partial Fourier and fewer partitions all help.
位相方向の FOV が体より小さく、反対側に体が折り返しています。折り返しをなく: The phase FOV is smaller than the body, so the body wraps onto the opposite side. Remove the aliasing (keeping the breath-hold within 20 s).
位相方向の FOV（%）を広げるか、位相オーバーサンプリングを使います。: Widen the phase FOV (%) or use phase oversampling.
位相方向は周波数で区別できないため、FOV の外の組織が反対側に重なります。FO: The phase direction cannot be separated by frequency, so tissue outside the FOV folds onto the opposite side. Fix it with a larger FOV, phase oversampling, swapping the phase direction, or saturation pulses.
加算を減らすと時間は半分、SNR は 1/√2 になります。ETL を増やすとぼ: Halving the averages halves the time and lowers SNR to 1/√2. A longer ETL adds blurring, so don't overdo it.
加速するほど SNR は下がります（√R と g 因子）。スライス厚を少し厚くし: More acceleration lowers SNR (√R and the g-factor). You can make slices a little thicker to compensate.

反転後に縦磁化が 0 を通る時刻（ヌルポイント）に励起すると、その組織の信号が消: Exciting when the longitudinal magnetization passes through zero after inversion (the null point) removes that tissue's signal.

水と脂肪の周波数差は約 3.4 ppm。1.5T では約 220 Hz なので、: Water and fat differ by about 3.4 ppm, about 220 Hz at 1.5 T, so one full phase cycle takes about 4.6 ms.
水と脂肪は 3.4 ppm 離れており、1.5T で 1 周 ≈ 4.6 ms。: Water and fat are 3.4 ppm apart; one cycle ≈ 4.6 ms at 1.5 T. In opposed-phase, water and fat in the same voxel cancel, so fat-containing lesions (adenoma, fatty liver) lose signal.
画素数（マトリクスやFOV）が違うため、差分は出せません。「並べる」か「スライダ: The pixel grids (matrix or FOV) differ, so no difference image can be made. Compare with "Side by side" or "Slider".

脂肪がまだ明るく残っています。脂肪の信号を筋肉の 3 割未満にしてください。: Fat is still bright. Bring the fat signal below 30% of muscle.
脂肪の T1 は短いので、TI ≈ 0.69 × T1(脂肪) ≈ 150 ms: Fat has a short T1, so its longitudinal magnetization reaches zero at TI ≈ 0.69 × T1(fat) ≈ 150 ms (1.5 T). STIR is robust to field inhomogeneity, but it also suppresses tissues with the same T1 (such as enhancing lesions).
脂肪抑制は STIR（反転回復）か Dixon が金属に強いです。: For fat suppression near metal, STIR (inversion recovery) or Dixon is robust.
選んだ2組織の信号差が0です。グラフで比べる組織を選び直してください。: The two selected tissues have no signal difference. Choose different tissues in the chart.
金属では局所の周波数ずれが大きく、読出し方向のずれ・スライス面の歪み・脂肪抑制の: Metal causes large local frequency offsets, leading to readout shifts, slice-plane distortion and failed fat suppression. The basic remedy combines high bandwidth, VAT, SEMAC and STIR/Dixon.
金属の周りで信号が抜け、脂肪抑制もむらになっています。金属アーチファクトを減らす: Signal drops out around the metal and fat suppression is uneven. Choose settings that reduce metal artifacts.
金属の近くは磁場が大きくずれるため、周波数で選ぶ方法（脂肪抑制・スライス選択・読: Near metal the field is strongly distorted, so anything that relies on frequency (fat suppression, slice selection, readout) is disrupted.
長い TR で縦磁化がほぼ回復し（T1 の差が消え）、長い TE で T2 の長: A long TR lets the longitudinal magnetization nearly recover (removing T1 differences), and a long TE leaves long-T2 tissue (CSF) bright, giving T2 weighting.

3D では「面内の加速」と「スライス方向の加速」を両方使えます。加速を分けると: In 3D you can accelerate both in-plane and along the slice direction. Splitting the acceleration keeps the g-factor small, so SNR drops less for the same total acceleration.

3T では同じ条件でも SAR が 1.5T の約 4 倍になります。リフォーカ: At 3 T, SAR is about four times that at 1.5 T for the same settings. The basics are lowering the refocusing angle to 120–150° (variable flip angles, hyperechoes) and using fewer pulses.
3T の DWI です。EPI の読出しを 28 ms 以下にして歪みを抑えつつ: This is 3 T DWI. Reduce distortion by bringing the EPI readout to 28 ms or less, while keeping SNR at 65% or more and scan time within 1 minute.
3T の FLAIR で SAR が高く、時間もかかっています。脳脊髄液を抑えた: This 3 T FLAIR has high SAR and takes long. Keep CSF suppressed while bringing SAR to 25% or less and scan time within 1 min 50 s.

ETL を伸ばすと時間が縮みますが、ぼけと SAR に注意。TI は TR に合: A longer ETL shortens the scan, but watch blurring and SAR. Keep TI at the CSF null point for the TR you choose.
ETL を減らす、TR を延ばすと、単位時間あたりの RF パルスが減ります。: A shorter ETL or a longer TR means fewer RF pulses per unit time.
FLAIR は長い TR が必要で時間がかかり、3T では SAR も制約になり: FLAIR needs a long TR, so it takes time, and at 3 T SAR is also a constraint. Combine a lower refocusing angle, a longer ETL and parallel imaging.
MPRAGE では反転後の縦磁化の回復が白質（T1 短）と灰白質（T1 長）で異: In MPRAGE, longitudinal magnetization recovers differently after inversion in white matter (short T1) and grey matter (long T1); reading out at the TI where the difference is largest maximizes CNR. The flip angle also affects saturation during the readout.
MRCP で胆汁だけを明るく、速く: MRCP: bright bile only, and faster
MRCP は非常に長い TE で、T2 の長い液体だけを残します。: MRCP uses a very long TE so that only long-T2 fluid remains.
SAR はフリップ角の 2 乗と B0 の 2 乗に比例します。リフォーカス角を: SAR scales with the square of the flip angle and the square of B0. Lowering the refocusing angle is the most effective step.
SNR はボクセル体積と √（加算回数）に比例します。薄いスライスで失った SN: SNR is proportional to voxel volume and √(averages). SNR lost to thin slices can be recovered by averaging, at the cost of scan time. Resolution, SNR and time trade off against each other.
T1 の差を消すには TR を長く、T2 の差を消すには TE を短くします。: A long TR removes T1 differences; a short TE removes T2 differences.
T1 強調は「短い TR」と「短い TE」です。: T1 weighting means a short TR and a short TE.
T2* 強調で出血を目立たせる: Make haemorrhage stand out with T2* weighting
TE 500〜700 ms で実質はほぼ消えます。時間は並列画像や部分フーリエで: With TE 500–700 ms the parenchyma almost disappears. Shorten the scan with parallel imaging or partial Fourier.

TE が短すぎて、出血がほとんど見えません。出血を白質の 4 割未満の暗さにして: TE is too short and the haemorrhage is barely visible. Make the haemorrhage darker than 40% of white matter (scan time within 6 minutes).
TE を長くすると、磁化率による位相のばらつき（T2*）で出血が暗くなります。: A longer TE darkens haemorrhage through susceptibility-induced dephasing (T2*).
TI（反転時間）で、灰白質と白質の縦磁化の差が最も大きい時刻を選びます。: Choose the TI (inversion time) at which the longitudinal magnetization of grey and white matter differs most.
TR 2500〜3000 ms、TE 15〜30 ms が目安です。: Aim for TR 2500–3000 ms and TE 15–30 ms.
TR 400〜600 ms、TE 10〜20 ms が目安です。: Aim for TR 400–600 ms and TE 10–20 ms.
いまは T1 強調の条件です。水素の量（プロトン密度）を反映する画像にしてくださ: The current settings are T1-weighted. Make an image that reflects the amount of hydrogen (proton density).
いまは T2 強調に近い条件です。白質が灰白質より明るく、脳脊髄液が暗い T1: The current settings are close to T2 weighting. Make a T1-weighted image in which white matter is brighter than grey matter and CSF is dark.
グラフの横軸を TI にして、CNR が最大の所を探しましょう。: Set the chart x-axis to TI and look for the maximum CNR.
